ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous fields on both lateral lobes; a central black anchor-shaped region extending from the peduncle into the notch with feathered, mottled transition zones; scattered dark linear streaks on the left lobe and a circular-annular mark on the interior right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a central intersection angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations present along the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased irregularity and protruding texture at the distal tips due to epibiotic growth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetrical sweep; the left lobe displays a steep upward convex trajectory, while the right lobe presents a more horizontal, slightly downward convex curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of brownish-white textured protrusions (barnacles) localized exclusively at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct dark, unaligned linear streaks on the left lobe; one prominent curved dark line on the interior right lobe near the central pigment boundary.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization (Coronula diadema) at the terminal ends of both lobes; visible circular scar or pigment ring on the right fluke lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A unique 'O' shaped dark pigment ring located in the lower-central region of the right lobe's white field.
